snippet.title: NEED FOR SCREAM - First Trailer. (Official Video).
snippet.description:
For those reading the description!
We’ve hidden some Steam keys in the video. The most attentive viewers might be able to grab a free game.
But no one knows how many keys there are—Grandpa got drunk on moonshine while editing the video and forgot everything.

THE GAME ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390000/Need_For_Scream

The year is 2010. You're going on a study exchange to Russia from the United States. You're also running your own blog, and everything is going great—until 2014... that is, until you learn about the cursed village and decide to go there to film a video for your followers.
